_meta.note: Label declaration terms used by the FSSAI engine. If an additive of `applies_to_category` is present but none of `accepted_phrases` appear in the scanned text, the engine adds ONE label-level finding (ingredient_id null) with status REVIEW. These checks detect label wording only; they do not decide whether an additive is permitted. Review against the latest amendment before production use.
_meta.source: FSSAI Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020, consolidated compendium Version VIII (09 Sep 2025), accessed 26 Sep 2026: https://www.fssai.gov.in/docs/food-law/regulations/Comp_Labelling%20Display_Version%20VIII_09_09_2025.pdf
